description: Add a table with its data, styled as PowerPoint inserts one: a header row, banded rows, the default style or one named.

continue.description: Rows past the page go on new slides after it, same box.

data.description: Cell texts, row by row; may be shorter than the table.

date_format.description: Dates of from as e.g. d mmmm yyyy or dd/mm/yyyy.

fill_box.description: Body rows share box h; else rows hug their text.

from.description: Or rows of d:<id> or t:<table>.

from_columns.description: from's columns, in order. Default all.

header.description: from's header texts; [] none. Default column names.

key.description: Retry key: a repeat with the same key makes nothing new.

measure.description: Add nothing: row heights, pages of h (0: content area), header repeated.

style.description: Table style name or id; describe lists the deck's own.

name: ppt_add_table
